race.comment: ON ANY TUESDAY (10) hasn't won for a little while but is ticking along nicely and should give us a great look under a light weight. Crowther takes over and will take some running down. JE CITY (3) made a complete mess of his rivals last start at Balaklava and finds a nice race to keep the ball rolling. Gets weight off and keeps Pannell. Can win again with surprising. STOLE HIM (4) was too bad to be true when resuming at Mildura. Can put that run behind him and give this a shake. GOLDEN GURU (2) is ticking along nicely and reunites with Holder. Drawn sticky but can overcome. GEETEE FORTY (13) is mixing his form but has peaks in his form that can be very competitive under the light weight of his 3kg claim. Don't leave out.
